Elis Glad

B2B App — Logistics & Traceability
Elis Paris Jan. 2023 — Jun. 2025 Paris, France
Native Android Here SDK NFC/RFID Industrial PDA

Project overview

B2B logistics application dedicated to Elis field agents (cleaning, uniform collection, mats, pest control). It organizes daily rounds, ensures item traceability and digitizes business processes on industrial PDAs.

Missions & features

Logistics and rounds

  • Route optimization by vehicle type with Here SDK V3/V4.
  • Round planning, distance calculation and ETA estimation.
  • Adaptation to pollution restrictions (ZFE).
  • Reporting of breaks, stops and travel times.

Traceability and inventory

  • Inventory management and item detection via UHF, HF, NFC, 2D and QR code.
  • Compatibility with Chainway and Zebra industrial PDAs.
  • Proof of visit: photo capture and QR code assignment.
  • Real-time synchronization with the back office.

Refactoring and performance

  • Progressive migration from Java to Kotlin with MVVM architecture.
  • Fixed all identified memory leaks.
  • Optimized loading and startup times.
  • Audited usage limits on industrial PDAs.

Results

  • International rollout: Brazil, Canada, Poland.
  • Adaptation to local customs and regulatory constraints.
  • Smooth and reliable app used daily by hundreds of field agents.
